t: The Site Wallinger overtrousers offer high waterproof protection with basic breathability in wet working conditions. These mens waterproof trousers feature double-stitched and taped seams for extra durability and weather protection. Reflective tape detail on legs provide enhanced visibility in poor or low light conditions. Designed in a regular fit with elasticated waist for comfort and 2 open access pockets for storing tools and essentials. Includes adjustable snap fastening at the hem allowing a perfect fit over work boots. These versatile overtrousers can withstand heavy rain or short bursts of water immersion making them ideal for outdoor work or when dependable waterproof protection is required. Machine washable at low temperature.
b: 50mm Reflective Tape on Legs Provides Enhanced Visibility
